hypothesis: A bounded move in ProteinAE latent space may resolve rare decoded clashes while retaining the decoder's local geometry, where direct residue translations failed. This is a new conditional inference intervention, not a change to raw-model qualification.
scope: All122 training families times32 saved CFG1 samples at both seeds. Optimize only initially invalid samples. Four longest valid controls, one per length bucket, at each seed verify saved latent/noise decoding. No native references, teacher structures, or experimental states enter optimization.
controls: FP32 AE3, original target/sample decoder seed and full padded bucket. Regenerated original latent must have CA-RMSD<=0.2A,CA-lDDT>=0.99 and exactly matching coarse validity versus stored sample. Fail whole experiment on mismatch. Model parameters frozen; no new decoder draws. Valid samples unchanged exactly; unsuccessful repair returns original. Every accepted output must pass all motion/local-geometry gates against the stored original.
resources: OneRTX10minute allocation,8minute work budget. Stored predictions and latents only; no DiT, ESM or teacher loading. Timing includes all-family CPU validity screening and conditional GPU repair with synchronization, excludes disk input, startup and independent audit. Report failed gates and actual overhead; no parameter grid.
followup: Only if both seeds pass training feasibility, test the new pipeline separately on unchanged native64 versus an original model with the same repair policy; retain raw baselines, all samples and all failures. Native qualification precedes external48 and matched end-to-end latency including screening/repair. Preserve locked tests. No promotion or thermodynamic-validity claim from training feasibility.
